embeddings.title: Waɗugo deftere
embeddings.description: Tabbitinki ko hawtidiri e defte ngam ɓe heɓa ko ɓe yiɗi nden ɓe holla ko ɓe yiɗi. Ɗu’um rakkay heɓa wakkati ɗuɗɗum ngam heɓuki defte mawɗe.

creation.musicLyricsGuide: Fe'itiri style e voice nder ko o yiɗi. Holla lincitol les tagji les. Tabbitini {{instrumental}} ngam vocals.
creation.setupAllDownload: Ɗaɓɓitugo e tiggugo kala huunde fu e laawol ngol
creation.setupStorage: Ɓurna fiiji: {{download}}. Resiiwa: {{reserve}}. Ɓurna nokkuure yiɗi: {{required}}. Ɓurna dow suɓol diidi: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: Wala {{missing}}. Holla nokkuure malla suɓi goɗɗum na'urawol ngol woodi na'uraaji ɗuɗɗi.
creation.setupTextNote: Alternatif binndol tan ngam yeewtere, binndol, kuutorɗe e jaabawuuli njuɓɓudi. Jippin: ko yowitii e {{size}}. Ina ɗaɓɓi ciimtol ɓurngol {{defaultModel}} tee ngol huutortaako natal walla odio e hoore mum. Jaabawuuli kaaleteeɗi kuutortoo ko daande system. Suɓo ɗum ngam golle binndol so aɗa jogii ciimtol keewngol. Ƴeewto jaabawuuli goonga e iwdiiji.
creation.setupImageNote: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Q4_K_M waddi footo; Qwen3 waddi bayaanu nden VAE waddi footo ragare. Go'o hakkiilo, raaru, seed, laayiiji e ɓeydaari mawnugo. fuɗɗoode ko yi'ata: 21:9, laayiiji nayi e seed.
creation.setupMusicNote: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo waaway waddugo gimi ko boo gimol. Planner waɗii tsari; 2B Q4_K_M generator synthesizes, binndi encoder laara bayanuuji nden VAE decode stereo 48 kHz audio. Holla wakkatiire, audio format, tempo, lyrics, ɗenngal, laabi e seed. Anndiraa: 30 sekondiiji, laabi tati, WAV 24-bit e seed random.
creation.setupVideoNote: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B Q4_K_M waɗata clipji gila bayanu. Anndaande: sekondiiji jowi, 21:9 e 16 FPS. Waɗata wakkatiire, frame rate, resolution, laayiiji e seed. Long targets assemble short clips; visible cuts are possible. · MP4: Python + imageio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: Hawta e hawta moodelji: LFM3-Omni + mmproj ngam binndi, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 ngam heɓtuki ɗemɗe ɗuɗɗe (CPU dow darnde), FLUX.2 Klein 4B e kuuje maaje ngam tagugo potto, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step ngam gimi (Instrumental dow darnde), e Wan2.1 ngam video. Laaru mawnugo fiiji, nokkuure diski e ko video yiɗi les. Hawta fere-fere e laara e woodi.
creation.videoDurationNote: Bidiyoji juutɗi e hawte diga ko seɗɗa; ko seɗɗa e laare boo e heɓe wakkati ɗuɗɗum.
creation.configure: Suɓta moodel cloud e keyji maagal API, maabo hawta suɓol injiniyaaku e fiiji ɗum tefataaɗi nder dabareeje waafuki.
creation.localNote: Footoji nanduɗi e naftira e foonduye Diffusers fuu, sennduki GGUF/Safetensors kuuje e stable-diffusion.cpp, maabo wallitiiɗum e native NVFP4 CUDA weights e Python. Video e naftira e Diffusers. CPU/GPU suɓol e feerotiri ngam encoder e fotootirɗum nder component-based engines.
creation.autosave: Fotoji e videoji ɓe timminaa e ɓe tabbitinaa nder Novera folders feere-feere nder deftere fotoji e videoji system, be ko ɓe tabbitini.
creation.autoNote: Ɗum heɓirta e ko ɗum yiɗi dow hokkugo footo malla video nder ɗemngal Faransa e ɗemngal Tuubankeere. Ɗum foti suɓa no ɗum heɓirta e hoore mun.
creation.source: Ɗum waaway naftoraago ko woni jooni dow hootowol ngol.
creation.variantPrompt: Ɓe waddii foondu kesum nde'e, e hoositirki ko ɓuri anndeeki.
creation.missing: Ɗu'um wanngii maa boo walaa faa anndaaki dow kompuuta kan.
creation.desktopOnly: Tiggugo hooto be video be nastinaaki automated ɗum heɓan to application desktop.
creation.inputUnsupported: Ɗum naftori hooto go'o ko suɓita ɗum. Videoji e hootoji ɗuɗɗi ko suɓita ɗum wala semmbe.
creation.animatePrompt: Wayla fotootirnde nde'e nden holla ko woni nder maare.
creation.filterNote: Fotiiji be bidiyoji nastina ko ɗum waddi. Na’uraji ɗuɗɗe no hollata ko ɗum waddi; ɗu’um wala ko ɗum hollata no ɗum waddi fotiiji be bidiyoji.
creation.inputRequired: Ɗu'um misaalu ngo'ol e yiɗi hooto inji.
creation.generationOnly: Ɗu'um moodel waɗii habaruuji. Suɓi ɗum nder fotootirgel maabo Video.
creation.cloudNote: Ɓe waddi Cloud generating to ɓe waddi ko ɓe yiɗi e ko ɓe yiɗi haa ɓe hokkata ko ɓe yiɗi boo ɓe waddi ko ɓe yiɗi boo ɓe waddi ko ɓe yiɗi.
creation.cloudDefaults: Cloud e naftira e presetji ko hokkata. Parameterji naane e naftira e suɓol naane ngal engine.
creation.cloudTimeout: Kuugal cloudiwal timminaaka nder wakkatiire nde ɗum timminii. Laaru darnde maajum e ko hokkata bako fuɗɗuki wadduki goɗɗum.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly e yiɗi keɓal token e x-api-key client identifier nder ko ɗum hokkata.
creation.catalogNote: Ɗu'um wadduɗo naftiri e limgal darndewol. Waylugo ɗum waɗataake ngam tabbitinki keywal malla nastugo lissafiiji ɗin. Ɗum waɗataake ngam foondugo daliilaaji.
creation.ggufImageModel: Diffusyon modele (GGUF maabo ko nandi e Safetensors)
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Encoder binndi (GGUF ko bo ko nandi e Safetensors)
creation.ggufVae: VAE (GGUF ko bo ko nanndi e Safetensors)
creation.ggufNote: Suɓta foonduki moodel, encoder binndi e VAE feere-feere. Ngam FLUX.2 Klein 4B, naftira encoder Qwen3-4B, hawti e GGUF feerootirɗum. Fiilaaji NVFP4 ko ɓeydata e ɓeydata e Python e PyTorch nder cache mawɗum ko ɓeydata; asliiji ɗo waylitaaka. Ɗu'um e yiɗi nokkuure diski ɓeydataande e RAM. To Windows, Novera hawtii e ɓeydata e ɓeydata e injiniyaaji. Auto e naftira ko hewti; CUDA e yiɗi CUDA tiggugo. Distilled Klein e naftira 4 laayiiji e CFG 1. Na ɗum nastina.
creation.ggufWrongModel: Ɗu'um GGUF hawtii e encoder binndi. Suɓi ɗum nder nokkuure encoder nden suɓi foondu feere nder nokkuure suura.
creation.nativeNote: Native NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy weights, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder and FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Needs Blackwell (RTX 50 series or compatible), Python, CUDA PyTorch and the optional NVFP4 dependencies. Text-to-picture only. Unsupported hardware fails explicitly; select stable-diffusion.cpp for compatibility. No BF16 diffusion cache.
creation.deviceNote: Ɗe'e kuje ɗo mari suɓol kare suɓol hoore maare. Auto huwira e kare kuutinirɗe; native NVFP4 fuu e ɗum yiɗi ko nandi e GPU ngam tagugo e naftira GPU encoding to VRAM yo ko hewti. Qwen dow CPU waaway taƴeeki VRAM amma encoding seɗɗa. Qwen dow GPU huwira e layer offload. Nder stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto tokki suɓol injiniyaare; fooɗugo CUDA e ɗum yiɗi CUDA tiggugo.
creation.totalTimeHint: Ɓurna wakkatijum hauti be nastugo, nastugo defte, tiggugo, ko ɗume je hollata, nastugo, be resuki. Tiggugo go’o ɗum holli fere-fere to mashinji holli ɗum.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: GPU generation, Qwen3-4B encoding on CPU, 4 steps, CFG 1. Tested on Windows with Vulkan; speed and compatibility depends on your hardware.
creation.seedNote: Fotoji nanduɗi tan, fottidiri e ko nanndi e suura man e darnde man.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Ɗuuɗal laaɓki nder Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. Ɗuuɗal hakkilanki yiɗi.
creation.upscaleNote: Ɓaawo tiggugo. E yiɗi Python/PyTorch. Ɓurna ko wurtina: ×2 4096 × 4096, ×4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Tabbitinii kadin tabbitinii ko yi'etee nder ko yi'etee nder Novera.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Waylugo raasiiji ɗo waylita raayiiji jooni. Dimenshiiji ɗo naftira be ɗuuɗal 16, yahugo 2048 px.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Ɗum waawata NVFP4 foondugo ngam heɓtuki NVIDIA Blackwell GPU ko boo kesum e ko yotti 4.5 GiB of VRAM. Ngam naftirki foondugo nder Novera, kala foondugo fuu doole laato waylitaama yahugo NVFP4 GGUF e kadin tabbitinaama. Ɗum foondugo man wala tabbitinaaki ngam darnde nde'e. Fiila Safetensors kawtataaka naa waaway nastinaaki ta laawol injiniyaare. Q8_0 laatike ko naftirtee. Naftoraaki deftere fuu ɗo jonngita dow juutal kontekst.
creation.setupOmniNote: Defaare e dow desktop e mobaayiil. Model ɓuuɓɗo ngam binndol, natal e odiyo, kuutortooɗo fiilde {{projector}} ɗaɓɓaande. Sokkit: ko yowitii e {{size}} wonande piille ɗiɗi ɗee kala. Suɓo ɗum ngam setup multimodal ɓurɗo hoybude. Feereeji daande fawii ko e platform e moteur. Konngol ɓurngol juutde ina huutoroo miijo ɓurngo heewde.
